title: claude-seo-ai Finding
description: A single audit finding. Falsifiability-first: every finding must be independently observable (evidence) and re-checkable (verification.reproduce). Impact is banded + confidence-tagged, never a fabricated percentage.

module.description: Owning module id (M1..M22, optionally with a sub-module letter, e.g. M7b for mobile, M7c for headings; the scorer maps it to its parent category).

status.description: needs_api = could not be verified without an API key/MCP/renderer; manual_review = a deterministic check could not decide (e.g. unsupported page language) and a human or model must judge. Both are NEVER a silent pass: the scorer excludes them from numerator and denominator and reports their counts.

severity.description: 0 = informational/unscored (probes, GSC AI exports, not_applicable — never moves a score); 1 = cosmetic; 2 = minor; 3 = moderate; 4 = major; 5 = catastrophic, eligibility-killing at site/template scope (site-wide noindex, robots blocking Googlebot, nosnippet/max-snippet:0 site-wide, CSR-only shell, robots 5xx). Only severity 5 + status fail + confidence established can cap a score.

resource.description: Platform resource the finding is attached to when it is not a URL/file, e.g. a Shopify theme asset, a WordPress option name, a sitemap file or a robots.txt group.

fixable.description: auto = deterministic/additive/verifiable write; proposed = draft requiring per-item accept; advisory = never written by the tool.

fix_preview.description: Unified diff or new-file content. Present when fixable is auto/proposed.

verification.description: How to confirm this finding independently. reproduce MUST be runnable.

reproduce.description: A concrete command or assertion a human/CI can run, e.g. 'node "<plugin_root>/scripts/validate-jsonld.mjs" --snapshot <pages/x.json>'. Prefer absolute paths (lib/finding.mjs reproduceCommand builds them).

expected_impact.description: Honest, banded impact. NO naked percentages — published numbers may appear only inside rationale with a citation.

confidence.description: established = documented by the engine; directional = strong correlational/industry evidence; speculative = plausible, unproven. Only established findings can cap a score (severity 5 + fail); directional and speculative findings never cap.
